Located a few steps from the Parc de Bercy and the quays of the Seine, the Aparthotel has very easy, 5 minute access to the Gare de Lyon, and 10 min access to the center of Paris by metro line 14. It has a seminar room that hosts up to 20 people.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris 13 Porte d'Italie
hotels.description: Giving pride of place to street art in the image of its district, the Novotel Paris 13 Porte d Italie hotel offers spacious bedrooms with modern decor. With a meeting room and a coworking space, our hotel in Kremlin-Bicetre also offers fun with family or friends around its board games or video games. To relax at the end of the day, come and discover our beers in our bar.

hotels.name: greet Paris Porte de la Chapelle-Aréna
hotels.description: Discover Paris first greet hotel. Local and eco-friendly, this renovated 2-star hotel is near Montmartre, Stade de France and the Exhibition Center. Ideal for work or leisure trips, our double and family rooms are warm and stylish. Easy access to Gare du Nord, CDG Airport. Near Porte de La Chapelle, quick access to the beltway and A1. Enjoy a unique experience at greet Paris Porte de la Chapelle-Arena.

hotels.name: ibis Paris la Defense Courbevoie
hotels.description: By the River Seine, the 3-star ibis Paris La Defense Courbevoie offers a comfy, affordable stay on the edge of Paris, near the La Defense business district. Some rooms have views of the Seine and the Eiffel Tower. During the day, after visiting the capital or before a concert at Paris La Defense Arena, take advantage of our bar in Courbevoie, open 24 hours, with its terrace and selection of light snacks.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Wagram Hotel
hotels.description: Near the Palais des Congrès, Porte Maillot and the Champs Elysées, just 10 minutes from the business district of La Défense, the Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Wagram Hotel is appreciated for its stylish and cozy setting. A welcoming hotel that invites you to relax after a day of work or shopping in the capital. Enjoy a delicious breakfast in your Family Room before setting off to explore Paris.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Maine Montparnasse 14th
hotels.description: In an old red-brick building, ibis Maine Montparnasse is a 10-min walk from Gare Montparnasse. For work or leisure, enjoy direct access to major event and tourist sites, like the Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and Paris Nord Villepinte, Eiffel Tower and Champs-Elysees. The hotel has 102 rooms with AC and new ibis bedding, free WiFi, bar and snack service and private parking, for a charge. Tight spaces.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette
hotels.description: In a district that feels more like a warm and lively Parisian village, the Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette will enchant you with its new décor. The Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette, a name often mentioned, refers to Haussmann's Opera district and the Grands Boulevards close by. Famous musicians and lyricists have long left their mark on this district, which is watched over by their patron saint, Saint Cecilia.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon Opéra Bastille
hotels.description: Close to Gare de Lyon, behind elegant late-19th century façade discover Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon Opera Bastille, where French lifestyle and Haussmannian charm combine. Appreciate contemporary aesthetics associated with classic Parisian prestige. Ideal location, hushed comfort of Privilege rooms, refined ambience of bar and piano, will appeal to business guests, families and lovers of the Capital.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Saint-Denis Pleyel Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Saint-Denis Pleyel is in the Pleyel business district, close to the Stade de France, shops and cinema, and just 10 minutes from central Paris by nearby metro. The 3-star aparthotel has 106 spacious and fully equipped apartments including 8 PRM, from studios to 2-room suites. Free WIFI, paid parking subject to availability.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access La Défense Place Charras
hotels.description: 5 minutes from La Défense business district and shopping malls, and 5 minutes by car from Plénitude Arena (formerly La Défense Arena) for concerts, events and performances. Our establishment in Courbevoie offers 97 modern and fully equipped studios, accommodating 1 to 4 people. Each studio features free WIFI and practical amenities for a comfortable stay, whether for business or leisure.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Issy Les Moulineaux Val de Seine
hotels.description: The ibis Issy-les-Moulineaux hotel is located near the Seine Musicale, Ile de St Germain and Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. It has 164 comfortable, air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI, a restaurant open for lunch and dinner, 4 seminar rooms and a private car park. You can also start your day with our rich, fresh, gourmet and diverse buffet breakfast!

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Ivry Quai de Seine Hotel
hotels.description: 5 minutes from Porte de Bercy, the Mercure Paris Ivry Quai de Seine hotel was renovated at the start of 2026 and offers rooms overlooking the river. Enjoyed by business travelers, our hotel in Ivry-sur-Seine has 10 meeting rooms and a business lounge to host your meetings. We offer tasty French cuisine with fresh seasonal produce, as well as a gourmet, healthy breakfast and a cozy bar.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Quai d'Ivry Aparthotel
hotels.description: The 3-star Adagio Access Paris Quai d'Ivry is close to the Seine and the Bibliothèque François-Mitterrand. There are 175 apartments, from studios to 2-room suites, fully furnished with an equipped kitchen. The aparthotel has paid parking and free WIFI. The nearby RER gets you to central Paris in 10 minutes. Discover Ivry-sur-Seine, the Moulin de la Tour and the Manufacture des Oeillets.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Rueil Malmaison
hotels.description: A partner for professional meetings and events, Novotel Paris Rueil Malmaison offers 14 meeting rooms and a conference hall. Our hotel in Rueil-Malmaison also welcomes families and tourists, and offers modern, stylish rooms and a fitness center. As for dining, discover delicious cuisine in a cozy and relaxed atmosphere. On fine days, relax on our new terrace and make the most of the moment.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris la Villette Aparthotel
hotels.description: The 3-star Adagio Access Paris La Villette is opposite Cité des Sciences, close to the park, the Grande Halle de La Villette, and the Zénith. There are 72 comfortable apartments with equipped kitchen, ranging from studios to 2-room apartments, along with free WIFI and two meeting rooms. Buses and the metro are next to the aparthotel. The establishment is not accessible to people with reduced mobility.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Porte de Charenton Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Porte de Charenton is in the south-east of Paris, near the Place de la Nation and Bois de Vincennes, with 134 fully furnished, user-friendly apartments from studios to 2-room suites. There is easy access to public transport, especially the 2 metro stations a few yards away, and to the beltway. Set in a quiet residential area, it is perfect for business guests and families.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare du Nord La Fayette 10th
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Gare du Nord La Fayette 10eme hotel promises an authentic Parisian experience. Fully renovated, the hotel has 70 modern and cozy rooms with air conditioning, new Sweet Bed by ibis bedding and high-speed WiFi. Kick-start the day with a buffet breakfast that includes a wide range of quality products. In the evening, enjoy a drink or a snack at the bar or in our private garden.

hotels.name: ibis Paris La Défense Esplanade
hotels.description: In the heart of the La Defense business district, the ibis Paris La Defense Centre hotel is ideally situated between the Grande Arche and the Arc de Triomphe. The hotel boasts a restaurant, bar and 286 air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI access. The near by Esplanade de la Defense metro station, line 1, provides easy access to the Porte Maillot convention center, the Champs Elysees and even the 4 Temps shopping mall within 10 minutes.

hotels.name: Ibis Clichy Centre Mairie
hotels.description: Renovated in 2017, in a cozy and design spirit, our 53-room boutique hotel provides you with all the equipment and services to make your tourist or business stays enjoyable. Relaxing, working with ease thanks to free WIFI, this is how we design our idea of hospitality and accommodation. We will listen to you for any requests to make your stay even more enjoyable.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Asnières Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Asnieres is on the outskirts of Paris near metro line 13, and has 132 fully furnished and equipped apartments, giving guests a practical and homely space. We also have 10 large PRM studios. The aparthotel is in a thriving area and close to La Defense for business guests, with good transport links to central Paris for leisure visits.

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de Montreuil
hotels.description: On business, pleasure or week-end trip, the Ibis Paris Porte de Montreuil budget hotel rooms provide every comfort. Small groups can take advantage of communicating rooms and a copious buffet breakfast in our bright breakfast room. Pay to leave your car in our private indoor car park and step onto the number 9 metro linking Porte de Montreuil to the Grands Boulevards and Trocadero district.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Charenton-le-Pont
hotels.description: On the edge of the Bois de Vincennes, the 4-star Novotel Paris Charenton le Pont is a prime address on the outskirts of Paris. Whether you're here for a family stay, a business trip or a corporate event, our hotel in Charenton-le-Pont enjoys an ideal location in a peaceful town just minutes from the capital. Committed to the environment, our hotel is Green Key certified.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Pont de Suresnes
hotels.description: In the heart of Suresnes, ibis Paris Pont de Suresnes is an air-conditioned hotel with 62 rooms, each with a private bathroom. It’s ideal for a stay near Paris and La Défense. There are 35 rooms with a double bed, 18 with two single beds and 9 triple rooms. A bar, coworking space, breakfast room and outdoor terrace complete the offering. Shops and restaurants are close by, with buses just a 2-minute walk away and tram line T2 8 minutes away. Paid public parking is nearby.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Montparnasse Pasteur
hotels.description: Inspired by Louis Pasteur's visionary spirit, Mercure Paris Montparnasse Pasteur invites you to explore and share. Feel at home from the very first moment. Our hotel has rooms for up to 4 guests, a sunlit glass atrium, co-working spaces, meeting rooms, L'Antidote bar and private parking. Experience the 15th arrondissement lifestyle with local gems, Parisian terraces and the Left Bank's authentic charm.

hotels.name: Pullman Paris la Defense
hotels.description: The upscale Pullman Paris La Defense hotel is a cozy and sparkling break with spacious designer rooms in La Defense business district, 10 minutes from the Champs-Elysees. There are delicious treats at the Quinte and Sens restaurant with its open kitchen, you can enjoy a drink at the bar, and there is also a gym and wellness area, WIFI, private parking, and meeting spaces for conferences and functions.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Alésia
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Alesia fully renovated 4-star hotel offering a warm and stylish setting in the 14th arrondissement. Ideal for business or a family stay in Paris, our hotel provides calm, modern rooms. Every morning, enjoy our breakfast, ranked 3rd best in France. Opposite Porte d Orleans metro station. Quick access: Montparnasse, St-Germain-des-Pres, Orly airport, university campus and Porte de Versailles.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Clichy Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Clichy is ideal for business or leisure, in a thriving city with plenty of shops and local color. Clichy-Levallois station is just 650 yards, for downtown Paris in just 6 minutes. Each apartment has been carefully decorated and equipped, with a full kitchen, high-speed internet, desk and TV offering a user-friendly environment.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Maisons-Alfort Aparthotel
hotels.description: Easily accessible by public transport, our aparthotel welcomes you to southeast Paris, near Place de la Nation and Bois de Vincennes. In a residential area, the property offers 102 studios for 1 to 4 people, each featuring an equipped kitchen, TV and WiFi. Enjoy a buffet breakfast, laundry facilities, parking booking required and pet-friendly accommodation. Ideal for business trips and family vacations.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio la Defense le Parc
hotels.description: On the edge of Paris, a short ride from the Champs-Elysees, Adagio La Defense Le Parc has 76 apartments including studios for 2 people and 2-bedroom apartments for 4 people. La Defense business center is less than 10 minutes on foot. Shops and amenities are nearby. A private undercover car park is available. The rate does not include city tax of up to EUR 14.95 per person per night, payable on site.

hotels.name: Mama Shelter Paris La Défense
hotels.description: Between La Défense, the Champs-Élysées and Paris La Défense Arena, Mama Shelter La Défense combines bold design, comfort and conviviality. Its 211 rooms, the penthouse with a view of the Seine and the lively dinner offer an ideal setting for working, strolling or relaxing. Families and children are welcomed with adapted menus and cribs on request, for a stress-free stay.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris La Défense Esplanade
hotels.description: Part of the iconic skyline, Novotel Paris La Defense Esplanade invites you to a relaxing urban hotel for families and business guests. Both near yet away from the hustle and bustle of La Defense. Join the locals at the Greem restaurant, play foosball in the lobby, enjoy drinks with friends or work out in the fitness center. Want to shine? Our nine meeting rooms will stimulate your creative spirit.

hotels.name: JO&JOE Paris Nation

It has been fully refurbished with the new OnTheRoad concept and welcomes you to its 136 new Cabrio rooms with en-suite shower and WC. Private paid parking and all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet.

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de Montmartre
hotels.description: The ibis budget Paris Porte de Montmartre hotel is located in the north of Paris, 2.5 miles, 4 km from the Stade de France and 10 minutes from Sacre-Coeur and the Montmartre district. Located near to the flea market in St-Ouen, our hotel has easy access to all the tourist attractions that Paris has to offer. For an affordable price, you can enjoy a break in a modern room with unlimited breakfast, 24-hour reception, free WIFI and a paying undercover car park.
